handback.title: Tests are the spec, and every text has two halves
handback.summary: The owner's tests lead the plan, stay locked, and every text the owner reads comes short with full detail folded.
handback.feature: Stories: (1) tests locked. (2) every role reads the ask. (3, 4) short and full texts. (5, 6, 7, 8) prompts. (9, 10) owner's commits.

stories.title: The plan check locks my tests and checks test docstrings
stories.user_story: Tests the owner writes stay exactly as written, and every new test explains itself in one shape.
stories.context: Owner's tests are tests added by commits on the branch whose author is not the bot (agent commits are authored by dokima-runtime[bot] and only co-credit the owner). The check lives in dokima/planner.py (problems, unsummarized, unnumbered, docstring_caps); agent_checks.worker_docstring_caps reuses planner.docstring_caps. The worker's fence already restores every test file. The Edge line is optional and capped when present. Newer words here win over open issue 546, which asked for fixed rigor kinds.

acceptance_criteria.text: A plan that changes a test the owner committed is rejected, naming that test.
acceptance_criteria.words: My tests are locked: agents may propose more but never change or drop mine.

edge_cases.case: A branch with no commits by the owner locks nothing.

acceptance_criteria.text: A plan that deletes a test the owner committed is rejected, naming that test.
acceptance_criteria.words: my tests cannot be changed by an agent
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Deleting is one case; the empty branch case is covered under changing a test.

acceptance_criteria.text: A plan that files no criterion for a test the owner committed is rejected, naming that test.
acceptance_criteria.words: A plan built on my tests keeps every one unchanged and maps each to a criterion.

edge_cases.case: The owner committed no tests, so nothing needs filing.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new or changed test with no User line in its docstring is rejected, naming the test.
acceptance_criteria.words: enforce this as a schema in test files

edge_cases.case: A test with no docstring at all is rejected the same way.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new or changed test with no Verified by line is rejected, naming the test.
acceptance_criteria.words: rigor line let's name it verified by line:
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Missing is the one case; an empty line counts as missing.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new or changed test with no Agent paragraph is rejected, naming the test.
acceptance_criteria.words: test docstrings user facing and agent facing
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Missing is the one case.

acceptance_criteria.text: An Agent paragraph of any length that names code passes the check.
acceptance_criteria.words: Agent holds the full detail, uncapped and folded on cards.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Passing is the case itself; its rejection twin is the missing paragraph.

acceptance_criteria.text: A User line over its word cap is rejected, naming the test and its word count.
acceptance_criteria.words: User, Verified by and Edge are short and capped

edge_cases.case: A line exactly at the cap passes.

acceptance_criteria.text: A Verified by line over its word cap is rejected, naming the test and its word count.
acceptance_criteria.words: User, Verified by and Edge are short and capped

edge_cases.case: A line exactly at the cap passes.

acceptance_criteria.text: An Edge line over its word cap is rejected, naming the test and its word count.
acceptance_criteria.words: User, Verified by and Edge are short and capped

edge_cases.case: A test with no Edge line passes.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new test file whose opening docstring has no user line is rejected.
acceptance_criteria.words: Each test file opens with the same pair: one user line, then agent detail.

edge_cases.case: A new file with no opening docstring is rejected the same way.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new test file whose opening docstring has no agent detail after its user line is rejected.
acceptance_criteria.words: Each test file opens with the same pair: one user line, then agent detail.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Missing is the one case; the no-docstring case is covered under the user line.

acceptance_criteria.text: An older test left unchanged passes the check without the new docstring shape.
acceptance_criteria.words: checked by code on new and changed tests only
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: Unchanged older tests are the case itself.

non_functional.text: Any plain sentence passes as a Verified by line; no list of test kinds is required.
non_functional.why: It must work in any repo, not only this one.
non_functional.words: please don't use categories finetuned for our repo only that will not fly. think longterm.
non_functional.no_edge_cases: It is a rule on every line; the passing case is the test.

stories.title: Every role reads the parent's ask and the owner's commands
stories.user_story: Every role on a story sees the parent's ask, and the owner's comments and commits steer the work.
stories.context: Today only the planner gets owner_words.json, with the parent's ask and owner comments (dokima/agent_roles.py, pack and owner_words). parent.json already reaches every role. route() in dokima/agent_roles.py already sends /review on a pull request to the code review and /plan to the planner; issue.md in every pack holds the owner's comments. The owner answered that plans live off the branch and are edited by comment.

acceptance_criteria.text: Text the owner committed on the branch counts as the owner's words a criterion may quote.

acceptance_criteria.text: The owner's comment that says /review on a pull request starts its code review.

acceptance_criteria.text: The owner's /plan comment reaches the next planner in its starting pack, word for word.

stories.title: A re-plan and code review keep the owner's commits
stories.user_story: Commits the owner pushes to a Dokima branch stay through a re-plan and reach the code review.
stories.context: Already true today; pin it with tests that run the real steps of .github/workflows/agent.yml, as tests/test_planner_starts_with_main.py does. Starting branch fetches try/issue-N when it exists; the pr stage writes git diff origin/main...HEAD to diff.patch. The owner closed #184, which would have deleted the branch. No workflow change is expected.

acceptance_criteria.text: A re-plan starts on the branch with the owner's commits still in it.
acceptance_criteria.words: a re-plan keeps my commits

acceptance_criteria.words: My work goes through the same reviews and checks as agent work.
acceptance_criteria.no_edge_cases: The owner's commits are the case; a branch without them is today's agent work.

stories.title: All tests run on the owner's commits
stories.user_story: The owner's pushes to a Dokima pull request get the same all tests check as agent work.
stories.context: Already true today: .github/workflows/full-suite.yml runs on pull_request_target synchronize, whoever pushed. Pin it with a test that reads the workflow's triggers and its author filter (there must be none).

acceptance_criteria.text: A push by the owner to a Dokima pull request runs all tests, with no rule skipping the owner.
acceptance_criteria.words: My work goes through the same reviews and checks as agent work.
